knowledge:
- key_parameters: k=length of k-mers used as features ;; m=maximum number of mismatches (mismatch kernel) or maximum number of wildcard positions (gappy pair kernel) ;; distWeight=distance weighting function or 1 for position-specific kernels ;; annSpec=logical indicating whether the kernel is annotation-specific ;; normalized=logical indicating whether to scale feature vectors to the unit sphere ;; presence=logical indicating whether only presence of a pattern is relevant, not its count ;; revComplement=logical indicating whether reverse complements are treated as identical ;; mixCoef=numeric vector of mixture coefficients for mixture kernels ;; pkg=SVM package to use ("e1071", "LiblineaR", or "kernlab") ;; svm=SVM type (e.g., "C-svc", "l1rl2l-svc", "nu-svr") ;; cost=unified cost hyperparameter for SVMs
- alternatives: procoil (specifically for coiled-coil prediction, though kebabs is faster and more flexible) ;; kernlab (for general string kernels, but kebabs is optimized for biological sequences and supports position-dependent/annotation-specific variants)
- when_to_use: When performing classification or regression on biological sequences where sequence patterns (k-mers, motifs, gaps) and potentially their positions or annotations (e.g., exon/intron, heptad) are predictive.
- pitfalls: Unbalanced datasets can distort standard accuracy; use balanced accuracy (BACC) or Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) instead ;; Comparing different kernels with the same hyperparameter values is inadequate; hyperparameters must be tuned individually for each kernel ;; Position-dependent kernels are considerably slower than position-independent ones ;; Explicit representations are not supported for position-specific kernels or distance-weighted kernels ;; Lowercase characters are ignored by default (ignoreLower=TRUE) and XStringSet classes convert them to uppercase automatically.

workflows.name: binary_sequence_classification
workflows.intent: Train a support vector machine classifier on biological sequences to predict binary labels and evaluate performance.
input: sequences.fasta (DNA, RNA, or amino acid sequences)
workflows.stages: 1. Define the sequence kernel ;; 2. Train the SVM model using kbsvm ;; 3. Predict labels on test sequences ;; 4. Evaluate prediction performance
workflows.code:
specK2 <- spectrumKernel(k=2)
model <- kbsvm(x=enhancerFB[train], y=yFB[train], kernel=specK2,
               pkg="e1071", svm="C-svc", cost=15)
pred <- predict(model, enhancerFB[test])
evaluatePrediction(pred, yFB[test], allLabels=unique(yFB))

workflows.name: grid_search_and_model_selection
workflows.intent: Perform grid search and cross-validation to select the best sequence kernel and SVM hyperparameters.
workflows.stages: 1. Define candidate kernels ;; 2. Run grid search with cross-validation using kbsvm ;; 3. Extract model selection results ;; 4. Plot performance across the grid
workflows.code:
model <- kbsvm(ccseq[train], y=yCC[train],
               kernel=c(gappy, gappya), pkg="LiblineaR", svm="C-svc",
               cost=c(1, 10, 50, 100, 200, 500), explicit="yes", cross=5,
               perfParameters="ALL", perfObjective="BACC",
               showProgress=TRUE)
result <- modelSelResult(model)
perfData <- performance(result)
plot(result, sel="BACC")

workflows.name: annotation_specific_classification
workflows.intent: Train a classifier that utilizes sequence annotations (e.g., exon/intron or heptad structures) aligned with the biological sequences.
input: annotations.txt (character strings of annotations of identical length to sequences)
workflows.stages: 1. Assign annotation metadata to sequences ;; 2. Define an annotation-specific kernel ;; 3. Train the SVM model ;; 4. Predict and evaluate
workflows.code:
annotationMetadata(ccseq, annCharset="abcdefg") <- ccannot
gappya <- gappyPairKernel(k=1, m=10, annSpec=TRUE)
model <- kbsvm(ccseq[train], y=yCC[train], kernel=gappya,
               pkg="LiblineaR", svm="C-svc", cost=100)
pred <- predict(model, ccseq[test])
evaluatePrediction(pred, yCC[test], allLabels=unique(yCC))

workflows.name: sequence_regression_and_feature_weights
workflows.intent: Train a regression model on biological sequences to predict continuous values and extract feature weights.
workflows.stages: 1. Define the sequence kernel ;; 2. Train a support vector regression model ;; 3. Predict continuous values ;; 4. Extract feature weights
workflows.code:
model <- kbsvm(x=enhancerFB[train], y=yReg[train],
               kernel=gappyK1M2, pkg="e1071", svm="nu-svr",
               nu=0.7)
pred <- predict(model, enhancerFB[test])
featWeights <- featureWeights(model)

workflows.name: prediction_profiling
workflows.intent: Generate prediction profiles to visualize the contribution of individual sequence positions to the model's prediction.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract feature weights and model offset ;; 2. Compute prediction profiles ;; 3. Plot prediction profiles
workflows.code:
predProf <- getPredictionProfile(GCN4, gappya,
                                 featureWeights(model),
                                 modelOffset(model))
plot(predProf, sel=1, ylim=c(-0.4, 0.2), heptads=TRUE, annotate=TRUE)
